## Aggregates and distinct

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t WHERE FALSE
=> "0"

## Aggregate limit and having modifiers

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(b ORDER BY a LIMIT 2), ',') FROM t WHERE a IS NOT NULL
=> "x,yy"

SELECT STRING_AGG(b, '|' ORDER BY a DESC LIMIT 2) FROM t
=> "あ|yy"

SELECT STRING_AGG(b LIMIT 1) FROM t WHERE FALSE
=> null

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(b HAVING MAX a), ',') FROM t
=> "あ"

## Approximate and by aggregates

SELECT APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(a) FROM t
=> "3"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(APPROX_QUANTILES(a, 2)) FROM t
=> "[1,2,3]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(APPROX_QUANTILES(DISTINCT x, 4)) FROM UNNEST([1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) AS x
=> "[1,2,3,4,5]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(APPROX_QUANTILES(a, 2)) FROM t WHERE FALSE
=> "null"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(APPROX_TOP_COUNT(x, 2)) FROM UNNEST(['a', NULL, 'b', 'b', NULL, NULL]) AS x
=> "[{\"value\":null,\"count\":3},{\"value\":\"b\",\"count\":2}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(APPROX_TOP_COUNT(x, 1)) FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 2]) AS x
=> "[{\"value\":2,\"count\":2}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(APPROX_TOP_COUNT(a, 1)) FROM t WHERE FALSE
=> "null"

SELECT MAX_BY(b, a) FROM t
=> "あ"

SELECT MIN_BY(b, a) FROM t
=> "x"

SELECT MAX_BY(x, y) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('a' AS x, 1 AS y), (NULL, 2)])
=> null

SELECT MIN_BY(b, a) OVER () FROM t LIMIT 1
=> "x"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG(x ORDER BY ARRAY_LENGTH(x))) FROM (SELECT [1, 2] AS x UNION
  ALL SELECT NULL UNION ALL SELECT [3])
=> "[3,1,2]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG(x ORDER BY ARRAY_LENGTH(x) DESC LIMIT 1)) FROM (SELECT [1, 2]
  AS x UNION ALL SELECT [3])
=> "[1,2]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG(x)) FROM (SELECT CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<INT64>) AS x)
=> "null"

## Percentiles

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(x, 0) OVER () FROM UNNEST([0, 3, NULL, 1, 2]) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "0.0"

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(x, 0.01) OVER () FROM UNNEST([0, 3, NULL, 1, 2]) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "0.03"

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(x, 0.5) OVER () FROM UNNEST([0, 3, NULL, 1, 2]) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "1.5"

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(x, 0.9) OVER () FROM UNNEST([0, 3, NULL, 1, 2]) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "2.7"

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(x, 1) OVER () FROM UNNEST([0, 3, NULL, 1, 2]) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "3.0"

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(x, 0 RESPECT NULLS) OVER () FROM UNNEST([0, 3, NULL, 1, 2]) AS x LIMIT 1
=> null

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(x, 0.01 RESPECT NULLS) OVER () FROM UNNEST([0, 3, NULL, 1, 2]) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "0.0"

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(x, 0.5 RESPECT NULLS) OVER () FROM UNNEST([0, 3, NULL, 1, 2]) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "1.0"

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(x, 0.9 RESPECT NULLS) OVER () FROM UNNEST([0, 3, NULL, 1, 2]) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "2.6"

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(x, 0.5) OVER () FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> null

# NaN sorts before every other value, and an interpolation that involves it is NaN.
SELECT IS_NAN(PERCENTILE_CONT(x, 0.375 RESPECT NULLS) OVER ()) FROM UNNEST([NULL, 1.0,
  CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64), CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)]) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "true"

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(x, 0.375) OVER () FROM UNNEST([100, -200, CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64), 70]) AS x
  LIMIT 1
=> "-166.25"

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(x, 0.5) OVER (PARTITION BY k) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS k, 1.0 AS x),
  (1, 2), (2, 10), (2, 20), (2, 40)]) WHERE k = 2 LIMIT 1
=> "20.0"

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(x, NUMERIC '0.2') OVER () FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC
  '99999999999999999999999999999.999999999', NUMERIC '-99999999999999999999999999999.999999999',
  NUMERIC '-1e-9', 0, 1, NUMERIC '-1e-9', NUMERIC '-10000000000000000000000000000.000000001',
  NUMERIC '99999999999999999999999999999.999999999',
  NUMERIC '-99999999999999999999999999999.999999999', NULL, NULL]) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "-46000000000000000000000000000"

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, 0) OVER () FROM UNNEST(['c', NULL, 'b', 'a']) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "a"

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, 0.5) OVER () FROM UNNEST(['c', NULL, 'b', 'a']) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "b"

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, 1) OVER () FROM UNNEST(['c', NULL, 'b', 'a']) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "c"

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, 0 RESPECT NULLS) OVER () FROM UNNEST(['c', NULL, 'b', 'a']) AS x LIMIT 1
=> null

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, 0.5 RESPECT NULLS) OVER () FROM UNNEST(['c', NULL, 'b', 'a']) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "a"

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, 1 RESPECT NULLS) OVER () FROM UNNEST(['c', NULL, 'b', 'a']) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "c"

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, 0) OVER () FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS STRING)]) AS x
=> null

SELECT IS_NAN(PERCENTILE_DISC(x, 0) OVER ()) FROM UNNEST([-100.0, NULL, CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64),
  CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64), 0, CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)]) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "true"

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, NUMERIC '0.5') OVER () FROM UNNEST([4, 1, 3, 2]) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "2"

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, 0.75) OVER () FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '1.5', 2.5, 0.5, 3.5]) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "2.5"

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, 0) OVER () FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS BIGNUMERIC), 0, 3.5,
  -1.23000000000000000000000000000000000001,
  BIGNUMERIC '578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819967',
  BIGNUMERIC '-578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819968'])
  AS x LIMIT 1
=> "-578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819968"

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, 0.375) OVER () FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS BIGNUMERIC), 0, 3.5,
  -1.23000000000000000000000000000000000001,
  BIGNUMERIC '578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819967',
  BIGNUMERIC '-578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819968'])
  AS x LIMIT 1
=> "-1.23000000000000000000000000000000000001"

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, 1) OVER () FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS BIGNUMERIC), 0, 3.5,
  -1.23000000000000000000000000000000000001,
  BIGNUMERIC '578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819967',
  BIGNUMERIC '-578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819968'])
  AS x LIMIT 1
=> "578960446186580977117854925043439539266.34992332820282019728792003956564819967"

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, BIGNUMERIC '0') OVER () FROM UNNEST([NULL, 'A1', 'a', 'A', 'z', ''])
  AS x LIMIT 1
=> ""

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, BIGNUMERIC '0.4') OVER () FROM UNNEST([NULL, 'A1', 'a', 'A', 'z', ''])
  AS x LIMIT 1
=> "A"

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, BIGNUMERIC '0.40000000000000000000000000000000000001') OVER ()
  FROM UNNEST([NULL, 'A1', 'a', 'A', 'z', '']) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "A1"

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, BIGNUMERIC '1') OVER () FROM UNNEST([NULL, 'A1', 'a', 'A', 'z', ''])
  AS x LIMIT 1
=> "z"

SELECT CAST(PERCENTILE_DISC(x, 0.5) OVER () AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2024-03-01',
  DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2024-02-01']) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "2024-02-01"

SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(x, 0.1) OVER () FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 10)) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "2"

SELECT CAST(PERCENTILE_CONT(x, 0.7) OVER () AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([0, 1, 2, 3]) AS x LIMIT 1
=> "2.0999999999999996"
